items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: He was responsible... He and Johnny Detroit... Well... There were... Two musicians... Who were more businessmen... Than the average musician...

ctx.x: That's where we were... Down there... On Bourbon Street... And, uh... He was responsible... He and Johnny Detroit... Well... There were... Two musicians... Who were more businessmen... Than the average musician... Because musicians are not... Not... Musicians are not businessmen... Uh-huh... In fact, my father had the opportunity... After we...
